result.title: VisualMontage: Manipulating the Beliefs of Vision-Language Agents with Authentic Image Sequences
result.summary: As agents based on vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly interpret social-media content, errors in their analysis may lend credibility to rumors and amplify their spread. In this paper, we study the problem of visual cognitive collusion, in which coordinated posts combine authentic images and locally faithful captions to induce VLM agents to infer and accept attacker-chosen target claims through their own reasoning. To enable systematic evaluation of this cognitive threat, we introduce a new benchmark comprising 544 target cases and 33.2K candidate images across eight application domains. We further propose VisualMontage, a multi-agent framework for simulating such attacks through narrative planning, image selection and ordering, and caption assignment under iterative review. We evaluate this threat through extensive experiments across 12 vision-language models, examining modality effects, production-team components, and downstream defenses. Using identical attack feeds across models without victim-specific optimization, we demonstrate cross-model transferability, achieving mean attack success rates of 61.93% for proprietary models and 68.71% for open-weight models. Moreover, 92.65% of generated feeds pass independent model-based validity auditing. Even after downstream review, residual attack success rates range from 35.3% to 76.7% across the evaluated configurations. Our additional controlled comparisons further reveal that captions can improve model-rated posting naturalness while reducing attack success. Together, these findings reveal a novel cognitive threat in social-media interpretation and motivate safeguards that assess how authentic posts jointly shape agents' reasoning and conclusions.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出「视觉认知共谋」威胁，构建含544个目标案例、33.2K候选图像的跨八领域基准，并给出VisualMontage多智能体框架，通过叙事规划、图像筛选排序与配文分配，诱导VLM智能体在自身推理中接受攻击者指定的目标主张。
AI.relevance_reason: 该基准与诊断可直接观察真实图像序列如何逐步改变VLM的结论与信念，可供核查视觉证据筛选、证据累积与结论收敛（停止）等问题，也可以检验内部状态是否保留后续图像可能推翻的视觉细节；但其重心在攻击与防御，未涉及latent状态生成或内部表示，故优先级偏低。
